title: AV-FlowEdit: Training-Free Prompt-Driven Audio-Visual Editing with Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation
title_zh: AV-FlowEdit：无需训练、提示驱动且保留事件感知频谱轨迹的音视频编辑方法

paragraphs.en: AV-FlowEdit 是一种无需训练和逆推的提示驱动式音视频编辑框架。 Joint audio-video diffusion models generate synchronized content, but editing existing clips requires target changes without disrupting non-target structure or cross-modal correspondence. We present AV-FlowEdit, a training-free and inversion-free framework for prompt-driven audio-video editing. Our key insight is that source--target flow differences provide both cross-modal editing directions and preservation cues. Under shared perturbations, they jointly update the video and audio branches, supporting visual-only, audio-only, and joint edits while retaining pretrained cross-modal interactions. To suppress drift accumulated during sampling, Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation combines flow saliency, aligned audio activity, multiscale low-frequency displacement, and diffusion-stage scheduling. This adaptively preserves unsupported regions while allowing intended audio-visual events. AV-FlowEdit requires no model training, external masks, or optimization-based inversion. Experiments show strong prompt alignment and temporal consistency, together with competitive audio quality and cross-modal coherence.
paragraphs.zh: AV-FlowEdit 是一种无需训练和逆推的提示驱动式音视频编辑框架。联合音频视频扩散模型能够生成同步内容，但编辑现有片段时需要在不破坏非目标结构或跨模态对应关系的前提下实现目标内容的更改。 我们提出了 AV-FlowEdit，这是一种无需训练和逆推的提示驱动式音视频编辑框架。 我们的核心见解是：源-目标流差异既提供了跨模态编辑方向，也提供了结构保留线索。 在共享扰动下，它们会同步更新视频和音频分支，从而支持仅视觉、仅音频及联合编辑，同时保留预训练的跨模态交互能力。 为抑制采样过程中累积的漂移，跨模态事件感知谱轨迹保持机制结合了流显著性、对齐的音频活动、多尺度低频位移以及扩散阶段调度策略。 该机制能够自适应地保留无法直接支持的区域，同时允许预期的音视频事件发生。 AV-FlowEdit 无需模型训练、外部掩码或基于优化的逆推过程。 实验表明，该方法在提示对齐和时序一致性方面表现优异，同时具备具有竞争力的音频质量和跨模态连贯性。
